activity_summary: Back at the lodging you said you had read the bill and that you were not crossing the river for it. You hung the cloak and turned to your own leaf.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the title once and hung the cloak up.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not crossing the river for another company's afternoon.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The post can keep its nail.
